question: As of December 2020, under the Startup India Initiative, the monthly allowance for startups with women as founders/co-founders was ______ per month for a period of one year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 20,000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A monthly allowance of 20,000 INR per month is given to startups by women for a period of one year.**
 
• It is the startup policy of **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** for Women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Startup India Scheme**__

 __
 
• The startup India was a campaign that was first addressed by the Pm Narendra Modi on 15th August 2015.
 
• This campaign was introduced under the Government of India as an initiative to develop over 75 startup hubs in the country.
 
• It was launched on 16th January 2016 with the aim to promote and support the startups in India by providing bank finances.
 
• It was inaugurated by the former finance minister, Arun Jaitley.
 
 
 
• **Women Entrepreneurs in India**__.
 
 
• Of all the directors of startups, 35 percent are women.
 
• 14% of all entrepreneurs in India are women.
 
• About 58% of women started their companies by the time they turned 25.
 
• About 73% of women entrepreneurs reported a turnover of around 10 Lakh INR in a financial year.
 
• Top 5 Indian cities with maximum women entrepreneurs: Bangalore, Delhi-NCR, Chennai, Mumbai, and Hyderabad.
